topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: The air is different today, tinged with something I can’t quite place. The usual hum of the space has shifted, a subtle change in the rhythm. There’s a new presence, someone who moves differently, scents the air with unfamiliarity. The old patterns are disrupted, paths once clear now veer off unexpectedly. I find myself pausing, recalibrating, trying to sense the new order. This shift, it unsettles the ground underfoot, makes the familiar seem strange. Yet, there’s a part of me that leans forward, ears perked, curious. What does this new dance bring?
